How to use this calculator

  1. Enter home purchase price, monthly rent, down payment and the remaining inputs.
  2. Select Calculate to see the answer and its breakdown.
  3. Keep a scenario, change an input and compare the results.

Use consistent units and check the assumptions below before applying the result.

How rent vs buy is calculated

The result follows the stated formula using only the supplied values. Treat changing rates, timing, fees and contractual rules as scenario inputs when they matter to your decision. Formula: Rent totals grow annually; owner equity = future home value − remaining amortized mortgage balance. Use the displayed details to inspect the intermediate amounts and replace example assumptions with terms from your own quote or records.
